name: sovo.
subtitle: Your audiobook library
description:
sovo. is your personal player for DRM-free audiobooks. Tap a book and start listening, right where you left off.

Bring books from Files, iCloud Drive, folders, ZIP archives, direct HTTPS downloads or browser transfer. Compatible imports automatically become one M4B with chapters; existing M4Bs stay unchanged and imported originals are retained. AAC conversion is lossy and needs extra storage.

Embedded tags and covers come first. Missing metadata and high-resolution covers are matched automatically using Apple Books and Open Library. Only confident matches are applied; your audio is never uploaded for metadata.

Your You page keeps Next, Listening and Finished books separate, with real listening minutes, a seven-day chart and a daily streak recorded on this device. An optional reader name makes it yours without creating an account.

Use chapters, bookmarks, speed, sleep timers, smart rewind, folders and a play queue. Optional iCloud sync keeps your library and playback position across devices.

Connections stay in Settings: browse your own Audiobookshelf or Jellyfin server, or bring Goodreads shelves into an independent in-app session or CSV snapshot. Goodreads is read-only; login and refresh depend on Goodreads.

No subscription, advertising or supplied audiobook catalogue. Import audio you are authorized to use; DRM-protected files are not supported.
reviewNotes: Version 1.0.1 (8) renames the installed app and extensions to sovo.; bundle IDs, iCloud container and App Group remain unchanged so existing libraries are retained. Main tabs are Library, You and Settings. Selecting a book starts playback immediately. Imports automatically convert compatible audio once and retain originals; no post-import conversion control remains. Automatic metadata uses Apple Books with an Open Library fallback; only title/author queries are sent, never audio. You displays local listening stats and library shelves. Optional Goodreads and media servers are in Settings. Goodreads uses an app-owned website session, is read-only, and supports CSV fallback; no official two-way API integration is claimed. Core import/playback requires no login, subscription or payment. Automatic genres use embedded tags and verified provider metadata. Goodreads profile/shelf snapshots can sync through private iCloud, excluding passwords and cookies; disconnect is local and disables that device’s Goodreads sync. AirPods sleep pause uses Apple’s system feature and standard remote pause commands; no HealthKit permissions, pulse collection, custom sleep diagnosis or workout sessions are used.
